title: Sodiophilic design for sodium-metal batteries: progress and prospects
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05871B, Review Article
Wanjie Gao, Yinxu Lu, Xu Tan, Tao Wang, Yueheng Yu, Yuhan Lu, Xinghao Zhang, Jie Wang, Yang Liu, Xi Liu, Bingyan Song, Shafi Ullah, Jiarui He, Yuping Wu
In this review, the formation mechanism of sodium dendrite and the corresponding battery failure causes are introduced in detail, and the latest advances in sodiophilic design strategies are systematically discussed.
